language.name: English
main.emptyTitle: Choose a recording — or drop it into the window
main.emptyHint: MP4, MKV, MOV, MP3, WAV, M4A and others. An hour of audio becomes a document in about 19 minutes on the graphics card. Everything runs on this computer, nothing leaves it.
main.noFilesHint: settings are already in place — just pick a file
queue.title: In queue
queue.dropHint: Drop it — I will add it to the queue
sound.title: Audio
asr.title: Recognition
out.title: Output
out.layout.subtitles: every subtitle line keeps its own timing
advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.sensitivityHint: higher picks up more quiet speech, lower keeps noise out of the text
advanced.chunkHint: longer keeps more context but gets stuck more often
advanced.threadsHint: only affects work on the processor
advanced.force: Transcribe again even if the document is ready
advanced.forceHint: otherwise ready files are skipped so the same 80 minutes are not spent twice
storage.shared: The folder is shared — it also holds %1 models of other programs; they are not shown or deleted here.
storage.empty: This will list what the program keeps on disk: ffmpeg for extracting audio and one or more recognition models. Each row shows its size, date and a Delete button. Everything is downloaded once and then works offline.
storage.locked: Work is in progress — deleting will be possible after it: the engine keeps the model open.
storage.ffmpegSystem: installed in the system, in %1 — left alone
storage.partialDetail: Download paused at %1 — what is downloaded is kept, it will continue from here.
storage.failedNetwork: Download failed at %1: no network. The downloaded part is kept — it will continue from here when the network is back.
storage.failedOther: Download failed at %1. The downloaded part is kept — you can retry.
storage.failedFfmpeg: Download failed — check the network and retry.
storage.tempDetail: Intermediate WAV files from earlier runs — %1, %2. Needed only to continue an interrupted job without extracting the audio again.
storage.footnote: Models can be downloaded again at any time. Deleting breaks nothing — the program will offer a download on the next run.
model.blurb.tiny: 99 languages · the fastest, noticeably more errors
model.blurb.base: 99 languages · very fast, fine for a draft
model.blurb.small: 99 languages · three times faster, more errors in names
model.blurb.medium: 99 languages · twice as fast, slightly lower quality
model.blurb.large-v3-turbo: 99 languages, much faster, slightly lower quality
diag.verdict.slow: ready to work, but slower than usual
diag.verdict.blocked: cannot work until the marked items are fixed
diag.status.cuda: ready: computing on the graphics card
diag.FFMPEG_MISSING.detail: Without it no sound can be taken from either video or audio. It downloads by itself, about %1 — or choose a folder where it already is.
diag.GPU_ABSENT: No NVIDIA graphics card — the processor computes
diag.GPU_ABSENT.detail: The engine accelerates only on NVIDIA cards. On the processor the text comes out the same, it just takes longer.
diag.GPU_MACOS: The processor computes — always so on a Mac
diag.GPU_MACOS.detail: The engine accelerates only through CUDA, and there is none on a Mac. The text comes out the same, it just takes longer.
diag.GPU_NO_CUDA: Graphics card found, but CUDA is not connected
diag.GPU_NO_CUDA.NO_CUDA_IN_BUILD: %1 is visible to the system, but this build has no CUDA libraries. I will compute on the processor — noticeably longer. A build with graphics card support is needed.
diag.GPU_NO_CUDA.NO_CUDA_LIBS: %1 is visible to the system, but cuBLAS and cuDNN were not found. I will compute on the processor — noticeably longer. Install nvidia-cublas-cu12 and nvidia-cudnn-cu12.
diag.GPU_OLD_DRIVER: Graphics card found, but CUDA does not respond
diag.GPU_OLD_DRIVER.detail: %1 is visible to the system, driver %2 is older than the engine needs: %3 or newer. I will compute on the processor — noticeably longer. After a driver update the check will pass by itself.
diag.GPU_SILENT: Graphics card found, but CUDA does not respond
diag.GPU_SILENT.detail: %1 is visible to the system (driver %2), but the engine does not see it. I will compute on the processor — noticeably longer. Updating the driver or restarting the computer usually helps.
diag.MODELS_READY.detail: %1 · all files in place · %2 chosen for work
diag.MODEL_CHOSEN_MISSING: The chosen model %1 is not downloaded
diag.MODEL_CHOSEN_MISSING.detail: It downloads on the first run — %1 and a few minutes; without network the run will stop. Already downloaded: %2.
diag.MODELS_NONE.detail: The chosen %1 downloads on the first run — %2 and a few minutes; without network the run will stop.
diag.TEMP_EMPTY.detail: Intermediate audio is removed after work — nothing piles up on disk.
diag.TEMP_PILED.detail: Intermediate audio from interrupted runs, %1. It is needed only to continue unfinished work — if you are not going to continue, it can be deleted.
diag.disk.need: A three-hour recording needs about %1 while working
diag.disk.low: . Free up space or delete unneeded models.
diag.logEmpty: No runs yet — the log appears after the first job.
setup.title.model: The recognition model needs downloading — once
setup.title.ready: Everything is in place — ready to work
setup.intro: The program computes everything on this computer, so its tools have to be stored locally. %1 in total, downloaded once and kept with you. After that no internet is needed at all. The files can be viewed and deleted in “Storage”.
setup.introReady: The tools are in place, no internet is needed anymore. The files can be viewed and deleted in “Storage”.
setup.ffmpegAbout: Takes the sound out of video and audio and converts it to the needed format. The program cannot start work without it.
setup.modelAbout.multi: Understands 99 languages. There are lighter variants — faster, but with more errors in names and terms; another model can be chosen on the main screen.
setup.modelAbout.en: Understands English only. For recordings in other languages choose another model on the main screen.
setup.ffmpegHome: ffmpeg goes to the program folder: %1.
setup.freeLow: %1 free on disk — not enough, %2 needed. Choose a folder on another disk.
setup.manual: If the network has a proxy or the download does not go, the model files can be taken manually from huggingface.co/%1 and put into %2 — the program will find them itself.
setup.status.private: none of your files is sent over the network
settings.title: Settings
settings.modelsHint: Several gigabytes. Can live off the system drive or point at models you already have.
settings.outputHint: Empty — save next to the source file.
settings.ffmpegHint: Empty — look in the app folder and in the system.
device.reason.NO_CUDA_ON_MACOS: no graphics card on Mac: the engine talks to them only through CUDA
device.reason.NO_CUDA_LIBS: graphics card unavailable: CUDA libraries not found
device.reason.NO_CUDA_IN_BUILD: this build has no graphics card support — get the CUDA build
run.title: In progress
run.etaSoon: an estimate will appear in a minute
run.stopping: I will finish this file and stop
run.cancelling: Stopping, saving what has been done
run.noticesEmpty: Nothing to report — which means it is all going to plan.
notice.DEVICE_FALLBACK: The graphics card is unavailable (%1). Running on the processor — noticeably slower.
notice.TRACK_FALLBACK: There is no track %1 in the file, taking the first one.
notice.SEGMENTS_REUSED: %1 was already transcribed with the same settings: building the document from it, a matter of seconds.
notice.OUTPUT_EXISTS: %1 has already been transcribed: the document is there, skipping the file.
notice.OUTPUT_RENAMED: The name is taken by another recording; the document for %1 will be called "%2".
notice.QUALITY_STUCK: Found stuck passages: %1. This usually happens on music, applause or long silence.
notice.TEMP_KEPT: The intermediate WAV was left on disk.
notice.TEMP_MOVE_FAILED: Could not move the intermediate WAV — left it where it was.
notice.STOP_REQUESTED: I will finish this file and stop.
notice.CANCEL_REQUESTED: Interrupting, saving what has been computed.
notice.MODEL_MISSING: Model %1 has not been downloaded yet — downloading %2, expect a few minutes of waiting.
notice.MODEL_LANGUAGE_MISMATCH: Model %1 only understands English, and the recording is in another language.
notice.FFMPEG_MISSING: ffmpeg is missing — without it there is no way to pull audio out of video.
notice.FFMPEG_FAILED: ffmpeg could not handle this file.
notice.NO_AUDIO_TRACK: The file has no audio track — nothing to transcribe.
notice.DISK_FULL: The disk is out of space.
run.loadingModel: loading model %1 — usually about a minute
run.cancellingFor: Stopping, saving what has been computed · %1
run.cancellingLoad: Waiting for the model to load: it cannot be interrupted midway · %1
main.modelWillDownload: Model %1 has not been downloaded yet — %2. I will fetch it and start right away.
asr.notNeeded: there will be no recognition — audio only
ready.modelNotNeeded: no model needed — there will be no recognition
advanced.asrOnly: recognition settings do not apply in this mode
result.title: Result
result.reused: Built from existing segments, without transcribing again.
result.skipped: skipped — the document was already there
result.partial: This is part of the recording: the work broke off, and only what was computed made it into the document.
